## Seat ruling on the dev's open questions (os-dev report `6272769577`)

`domain:ui` seat 2, session `session_01XVp19E1MYUTFM3dnkwz8gB`, 2026-10-19T17:09Z.

**What the seat checked at objectui's pin (`18.0.0-next.5`):**
- `ObjectFieldGroupSchema.visibleWhen` declares "else hidden (fail-closed)" (`object.zod.ts:1263`).
- The form-view `FormSectionSchema.visibleWhen` declares that on an unbound root "the predicate faults open" (`view.zod.ts:3837`).
- On the form, both arrive on the same section-divider row, so the renderer cannot honour both from the slot alone. The fault direction has to travel with the predicate's origin.

**Q1: A.** The route is the card's own: follow the spec as declared (triage `6271935463`). Option C (change the spec's direction) is not taken, and B (a half that makes the two surfaces disagree) is refused. Conditions:
- **One runtime hand-off key, a closed enum, not a boolean.** It names the fault direction the predicate's origin declares, for example `visibleWhenFault: 'hidden' | 'shown'` with absent meaning today's fail-open. `deriveFieldGroupSections` stamps it. Every rebuild arm and `projectSectionDivider` carry it unchanged. `form.tsx`'s divider, `hiddenSectionFieldNames`, tab and pane gates read it for their fault fallback. `record:details` hides a faulting group in the same PR. The dev may pick a better name that fits the tree; the contract review judges it.
- **Only these two origins change.** A form-view section and every other predicate slot keep today's fail-open. ⛔ No global fallback flip.
- **Declared, so `Clause-②: yes`.** The key crosses a package boundary, so it is declared on the `@object-ui/types` face that carries the row (`FormField` / `ObjectFormSection` / `FormFieldTab`, wherever the rows are typed). Changeset: `minor` on `@object-ui/types`, `patch` elsewhere. The seat runs a contract review before ACCEPT.
- **Rebuild sites need an enumeration pin.** Pin every arm that rebuilds a section key by key (`ObjectForm` ×5, `ModalForm` ×2, `DrawerForm` ×2, `SplitForm`, `TabbedForm`, the console `FormPage`) so that a new arm cannot drop the key silently.
- **The surface widens to those named files, `@object-ui/components` `renderers/form/form.tsx`, and the `@object-ui/types` row types.** `FormSection.tsx` is dropped from it: it gates nothing.

**Q2: A.** Members of a group hidden by a fault behave exactly like members of a group hidden by a false predicate: values still submit and validation is skipped, per the maintainer's ruling of 2026-08-27 cited in `form.tsx` (objectui#6236). The order's headline was a paraphrase; the body ("keep it identical") governs.

**Not this card:** authoring accepts a syntactically broken group `visibleWhen` with a 200. That stays a note in Acceptance notes.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `015326cf238ffe95843ce00765f3b66a896f4d6d`
Local-runs: none

Inputs read: card #13055 body and all four comments (triage `6271935463`, claim `6272665027`, os-dev-report `6272769577`, ruling `6272824447`); PR #13069 body, its 22-file list and the full net diff against `main` (1467 diff lines, read end to end); the 35 check-runs on the head; the spec source for `ObjectFieldGroupSchema.visibleWhen` and `FormSectionSchema.visibleWhen` (read-only, from the `packages/spec` source tree); `FormFieldPane` in `packages/types/src/form.ts` and the `ObjectFormSection` imports of the four layout files, read from the checkout to answer two brief questions the diff alone cannot. Nothing built, run or re-run.

### ① Derived judgments

1. **The key — right.** `visibleWhenFault?: 'hidden' | 'shown'` is a closed two-value enum, declared once on each carrying type: `ObjectFormSection` (`objectql.ts`), `FormField` (`form.ts`, docblock scopes it to `section-divider` rows and says every other row ignores it) and `FormFieldTab` (`form.ts`). Absent is documented as today's fail-open on all three. The zod mirrors match exactly: `FormFieldSchema.visibleWhenFault` and the module-private `FormFieldTabEntrySchema.visibleWhenFault`, both `z.enum(['hidden','shown']).optional()`. The two edited type-census pins (`object-form-section-style-keys-undeclared`, `form-field-zod-coverage`) each gain the one key and nothing else. No boolean, no third value, no second spelling.

2. **Stamp and carry — right.** `deriveFieldGroupSections` emits `visibleWhenFault: 'hidden'` only when the group carries a `visibleWhen` (so an ungated group stays unstamped — pinned by "stamps nothing on a group that declares no predicate"). Every key-by-key rebuild copies it on the line after `visibleWhen`: `ObjectForm` ×5 (tabbed, split, drawer, modal maps and `SimpleObjectForm`), `ModalForm` ×4 (section map, tab copy, stacked `g` projection, derived section), `DrawerForm` ×2, `SplitForm` ×1, `TabbedForm` ×3 (section map, degraded `__section_gate_` row, tab copy), console `FormPage.buildSections` ×1. `projectSectionDivider` copies it onto both row shapes (titled divider and headingless `__section_gate_` row) and omits it when absent, pinned behaviourally. The four layout section-config interfaces type the key by reference, `ObjectFormSection['visibleWhenFault']`, and all four files already import `ObjectFormSection` (verified in the checkout), so the reference resolves.

3. **The enumeration pin — real, with one bounded limit.** `sectionFaultCarry-13055` scans every non-test `plugin-form` source plus `FormPage.tsx`, comments masked by the shared `scripts/js-comment-mask.mjs`, for `visibleWhen: RECV.visibleWhen,` (and the `(RECV as any)` spelling), classifies the receiver (section: `s`, `section`, `sec`, `g`; field: `field`, `override`, `def`), fails loudly on an unclassified receiver, requires the next code line to be `visibleWhenFault: RECV.visibleWhenFault,` for every section receiver, and pins the per-file site counts (5/4/2/1/3/1 = the 16 sites in the diff) as the liveness half. The dev's ablation 2 (drop the key from `SplitForm`) reports the pin going red by file. Limit, not a defect: the scanner matches one spelling of a copy; a future arm that copies the predicate under a different spelling (a spread, a renamed receiver, a non-trailing-comma form) is not seen by it. The unclassified-receiver leg catches the renamed-receiver case; the spread case is outside the pin. Adequate for the ruling's "a new arm cannot drop the key silently" on the arms that exist.

4. **`form.tsx` reads the key only for a stamped divider — right.** `isFailClosedSectionGate` is true only for `type === 'section-divider'` with `visibleWhenFault === 'hidden'` and a non-null `visibleWhen`. At each of the four divider-judging sites (`renderFormField`, `hiddenSectionFieldNames`, `conditionallyHiddenFieldNames`, `readonlyFieldNames`) such a row's `visibleWhen` is passed to `resolveFieldRuleState` as `undefined` and judged instead by `sectionGateVisible`, which is `evalFieldPredicate(..., false, ...)` with the same record, previous and scope. `readonlyFieldNames` only drops it from the triad, which is correct since that memo reads `readonly` only. The tab gate (`hiddenFieldTabKeys`) uses `!failClosed` as the fallback, so an unstamped tab keeps `true`. Pane: `FormFieldPane` declares `key`, `fields`, `defaultSize`, `minSize`, `containerClass` and no predicate slot (verified), so the dev's "no pane gate to change" is correct; the split layout gates through the `section-divider` rows inside each pane, which carry the key. Unstamped section, tab and field predicates keep fallback `true`: the triad call is untouched for them, and the (b) controls pin an unstamped divider, an unstamped tab, a `'shown'`-stamped divider and a field-level `visibleWhen` carrying the key (ignored off a divider) as still shown with `safe default (true)`. No global fallback flip. The ADR-0137 D2 submit refusal is unaffected: the `faulted` list already excluded divider rows and a gated divider's triad `visibleWhen` is absent, so nothing new reaches it.

5. **`record:details` — right.** `sectionPredicateVisible` now calls `evalFieldPredicate(visibleWhen, record, false, record, scope, ...)`, the same engine, record and previous as before, fallback `false`, with a fail-closed locator. Only `{ group }` references reach it, so there is no fail-open origin to separate there. The 11630 matrix asserts the form and the page agree on every fault row.

6. **Hidden members still submit and skip validation — right.** The fault hide goes through the same `hiddenSectionFieldNames` set as a FALSE verdict (the objectui#6236 block), with no change to `shouldUnregister` or the Controller unmount. The Q2 block of `section-gate-fail-closed-13055` runs the identical two assertions (value still in the `onSubmit` payload; a `required` member does not block) over a FALSE-hidden and a FAULT-hidden group. This is the 2026-08-27 ruling, Q2 A.

7. **Edited existing pins — changed only where the ruling forces it.** 11630: the "bare identifier" and "parse error" rows flip from `[true, true]` to `[false, false]` (an unbound identifier is a fault, so the flip is forced) and one "unknown field" row is added; the well-formed, no-predicate, null-compare, relation, `previous` and scope rows are untouched; the form leg gains the `'hidden'` stamp beside the predicate, which is what `projectSectionDivider` now emits. 12720: only the fault leg changes (body hides, zero members on the page); the hidden and shown legs are untouched. The two types censuses gain the one key. Nothing else in an existing pin moves.

8. **Docs — right.** `plugin-form.mdx` "Conditional tabs" states the exception for a tab or section built from an object field group (fail-closed, header, trigger, panel and members hidden, `record:details` the same, the `safe default (false)` diagnostic, members behave as under FALSE, form-view section, form-authored `fieldTabs[].visibleWhen` and field `visibleWhen` keep failing open, and names the hand-off key). `metadata-diagnostics.md` states the same split in its runtime-fault paragraph. Both match the behaviour in the diff and the changeset body.

9. **Spec text — no contradiction.** `ObjectFieldGroupSchema.visibleWhen` describe: "shown only when TRUE, else hidden (fail-closed)"; its docblock: "a faulting predicate — fail-closed) hides the WHOLE group, header included". `FormSectionSchema.visibleWhen` describe: "the root is unbound and the predicate faults open". The split this PR implements is exactly the two declarations. The spec's strict `FormSectionSchema` does not declare `visibleWhenFault`, so authored spec metadata cannot carry it; the key exists only on objectui's `@object-ui/types` row faces.

10. **One observation, not a defect.** The docblocks call the key "not an authoring key", but on objectui's own `form` / `object-form` JSON dialect (`FormField`, `FormFieldTab`, `ObjectFormSection` are authorable there and the zod mirrors accept the key) an author CAN write `visibleWhenFault: 'hidden'` on a hand-written section-divider row or tab and opt it into fail-closed. The spec face refuses it; the objectui face accepts it. This is the shape the ruling asked for (declared on the row types, `zod-mirror-parity` honoured) and an opt-in to the stricter direction is harmless; the "not an authoring key" wording is advisory on the objectui face. Named here so the seat does not read it as enforced.

### ② Semver level

`.changeset/13055-field-group-fail-closed.md` declares `@object-ui/types: minor` and `patch` on `@object-ui/components`, `@object-ui/plugin-form`, `@object-ui/plugin-detail`, `@object-ui/console`. That matches what the diff publishes: the one widening of a public face is the three optional-key declarations and two zod additions on `@object-ui/types` (additive, no removal or narrowing, so `minor`, not `major`; AGENTS.md rules `major` out of a fixed-group changeset in any case and `check-changeset-no-major` passed). The four other packages change behaviour behind an existing face (a fail direction and a diagnostic string) and export no new symbol: `patch`. Every package whose `src/` the diff touches is declared (`apps/console` is in the `fixed` group per AGENTS.md and is listed); `packages/types` is declared. The body names the key, the stamp, absent-means-fail-open, what stays fail-open and the Q2 submit behaviour, and contradicts none of its own front matter. Check-runs: Changeset Declaration, Changeset Bump Policy, Changeset Fixed Group Check, Changeset Overwrite Report and Changeset Claim Re-read all `success`.

`Clause-②:` yes — correct. The PR widens the `@object-ui/types` face by one declared runtime hand-off key, as ruling `6272824447` amended the claim to allow.

### ③ Boundary flags

- **Q1 (how to carry the direction; may the surface grow)** — ruled A on the card; implemented as ruled: one closed enum, stamped by `deriveFieldGroupSections`, carried by every arm and `projectSectionDivider`, read at the divider, `hiddenSectionFieldNames`, tab gate (no pane slot exists), `record:details` in the same PR, enumeration pin present. Answered.
- **Q2 (do hidden members submit)** — ruled A; implemented and pinned as the FALSE-predicate equivalence. Answered.
- **Out-of-scope 1 (authoring accepts a broken group `visibleWhen` with 200)** — ruled "not this card"; the PR's Acceptance notes carry it as a note. Stays a note; no card filed in this review.
- **Out-of-scope 2 (`FormSection.tsx` gates nothing)** — the ruling dropped it from the surface; the diff does not touch it. Closed.
- **PR flag: docs follow-up** — resolved in the docs round (`plugin-form.mdx`, `metadata-diagnostics.md` in the diff). Closed.
- **PR flag: `app-shell` `SchemaForm` untouched** — it resolves `{ group }` against no field groups and never carries a group predicate; leaving it is correct. Closed.
- **PR flag: a headingless field group on `formType: 'split'` has no gate at all (pre-existing)** — true from the diff's own `projectSectionDivider` reading only when the split layout skips the row; not this card's slot direction. Escalated as a note for the seat: it is a separate pre-existing gap, worth a card of its own if a real app authors a label-less gated group on a split form.
- **PR flag: "the zod mirror now accepts the key on an authored form"** — answered in ① item 10: accepted, with the advisory nature of "not an authoring key" on the objectui face named.
- **PR flag: `check:spec-floors` exits 1 locally (no-artifact, wants a whole-workspace build)** — recorded per the dispatch; the `Repo Gates` check-run on the head is the authority and is still in progress.
- **Check-runs still in progress at review time:** Type Check, Lint, Repo Gates, Build & E2E, Build Docs, Bundle Analysis, Test (dist pins), Test shards 1-16/16, Live E2E (informational). Completed and `success`: the five Changeset checks, Line Citation Gate, Governed Surface Queue Guard, label. Skipped: Test (coverage), coverage shards, dependabot. Nothing has failed. This record judges the contract; the adopting seat reads the remaining conclusions before ACCEPT and does not treat this PASS as covering them.

- **Premise:** holds. `record:details` and the form judged a faulting field-group `visibleWhen` with the triad's fail-open fallback. The spec declares this slot fail-closed (`ObjectFieldGroupSchema.visibleWhen`), while a form-view `FormSection.visibleWhen` faults open, and both reach one divider row.
- **Diff read by the seat:**
